meta.title: Devlog: October 25, 2026 - November 1, 2026
meta.description: a week of library sharing, direct media uploads, voting transparency, and connection-flow updates.

bullets.text: continued routine maintenance work is in progress.

summary.text: i kept this one tidy behind the scenes this week.

bullets.text: shipped a dedicated, privacy-conscious return page to help people complete an instagram connection in their local studio.
added the required website verification response for tiktok ownership checks.
made guest book voting more transparent with ranked pick breakdowns and required participant names for nominations and ballots.

summary.text: i spent some time making the site a more useful bridge for connected tools, while also making the book vote flow easier to trust at a glance.

bullets.text: released transparent ranked-vote results that show pick counts and how points are calculated.
made guest names required across nominations and ballots, with saved names carried through the voting flow.
improved required-field states and disabled actions across key account, club, and onboarding forms.

summary.text: i wanted the voting experience to feel more legible and a little less mysterious, because arithmetic should not be the plot twist.

bullets.text: shipped media-library sharing between devices so saved editorial work can travel with a shared library while local work stays local.
added sharing readiness checks that surface unavailable files and help people resolve issues without blocking usable media.
shipped direct uploads for complete clips and slides, with manual categories and optional descriptive analysis.
kept direct uploads separate from source ingestion so manually added library items do not clutter source workflows.

summary.text: this was a big week for making the media library feel portable and less precious. i also started poking at analytics, because apparently the work is never allowed to stay in one lane.

bullets.text: updated the production creative library with refreshed video and slideshow assets.
revised video drafts with new clip selections, messaging, and accountability-focused demonstrations.
added and organized new slideshow material for future social content.

summary.text: i refreshed the creative bench this week and kept iterating on how the product story comes across in short-form content.
